title: How SpaceX benefits from its Cursor acquisition
title_zh: SpaceX 如何从收购 Cursor 中获益
summary: SpaceX's SpaceXAI should get a solid boost from its Cursor acquisition, but it will still need to compete with rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic.
summary_zh: SpaceX 旗下的 SpaceXAI 应该会从 Cursor 收购中获得坚实的推动力，但它仍然需要与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等竞争对手竞争。

title: Canada's MDA Space to buy Blue Canyon in $620 million deal
title_zh: 加拿大 MDA Space 斥资 6.2 亿美元收购 Blue Canyon
summary: June 19 (Reuters) - Canadian space technology firm MDA Space said on Friday it would buy U.S.-based Blue Canyon Technologies from RTX's Raytheon business for $620 million in cash, expanding its
summary_zh: 路透 6 月 19 日 - 加拿大太空技术公司 MDA Space 周五表示，将以 6.2 亿美元现金从 RTX 雷神公司业务手中收购总部位于美国的 Blue Canyon Technologies，扩大其业务规模。

title: SpaceX (SPCX) Is Up 14.9% After Record IPO And $60 Billion Cursor AI Deal - What's Changed
title_zh: SpaceX (SPCX) 在创纪录的 IPO 和 600 亿美元 Cursor AI 交易后上涨 14.9% - 发生了什么变化
summary: In mid-June 2026, Space Exploration Technologies Corp. completed the largest IPO in history, raising roughly US$75–86 billion and rapidly secured inclusion in major Nasdaq indexes while agreeing to acquire AI coding platform Cursor in an all-stock deal valued at US$60 billion.
summary_zh: 2026 年 6 月中旬，Space Exploration Technologies Corp. 完成了历史上最大规模的 IPO，筹集了约 75-860 亿美元，并迅速纳入纳斯达克主要指数，同时同意以价值 600 亿美元的全股票交易收购人工智能编码平台 Cursor。

title: Review & Preview: Peace Deal Trumps Fed
title_zh: 回顾与前瞻：和平协议胜过美联储
summary: Progress toward a peace deal with Iran outweighed hawkish undertones from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. Plus, the Knicks’ market impact.
summary_zh: 与伊朗达成和平协议的进展盖过了美联储主席凯文·沃什的鹰派暗示。另外，尼克斯队的市场影响力。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq And Dow End Holiday-Shortened Week Higher As Investors Cheer US-Iran Peace Deal — SPCX, AMZN, ONDS, NFLX, TTWO In Focus
title_zh: 由于投资者欢呼美伊和平协议，标普 500 指数、纳斯达克指数和道琼斯指数在假期缩短的一周中上涨 - SPCX、AMZN、ONDS、NFLX、TTWO 成为焦点
summary: Donald Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian signed a preliminary agreement on Wednesday in a bid to end the conflict between the two countries.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普和伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安周三签署了一项初步协议，以结束两国之间的冲突。
